messages:
Rowan: PSA: high tide splash at Embarcadero just caught a line of bikers off-guard. Water sprayed over the seawall — several soggy helmets and one floating banana peel. Commute = wet. :ocean: :banana:
Asha: I almost lost my laptop bag to a rogue wave. Someone should invent commuter wetsuit pockets. :laughing:
Diego: Bike lane looked like a river. Stopped under the pier and watched a skateboarder surf the puddle. San Francisco is performance art today. :sunglasses:
Mina: Left a bin of ziplock bags and a couple of drying towels with concierge. Also tucked a handwritten note: "Emergency banana collection". :memo: :tropical_fish:
TransitBot: Ferry/Embarcadero alert: https://sf-transit.example/alerts/214000 | emba_promenade: splashing incident; pedestrian detour in effect; expect delays for surface shuttles. est_delay: 15-40 mins
Rowan: Felix, saw you cycling past — your rain poncho became a kite. You good? :wind_face:
Felix: Still airborne but managed to right myself. Left one soaked glove at the desk. If you find it please return to "Felix's glove rescue fund".
Asha: Micro-poll: should we add a small "beach kit" to the lobby for these weird splash events? Towels, ziplocks, coping bananas. React :beach_umbrella: for yes, :shrug: for no.
Diego: :beach_umbrella: also add a tiny flag that says "High Tide Heroes" for anyone who helps.
Mina: Dropping a note in #facilities to ask about adding a waterproof mat at the Embarcadero entrance. Also, kudos to the bike commuter who scooped up the banana before anyone slipped. :clap:
Rowan: Status check: who made it in and who diverted? Reply one-line with your neighborhood + mode. I'll compile for the morning log.
Diego: South Beach -> walked; shoes wet but spirit intact.
Felix: Mission -> rode; glove tragedy.
Asha: North Beach -> delayed ferry, rerouted via BART.
Mina: Embarcadero -> in, brought towels.
Rowan: Thanks all. If you need a banana retrieval or a dry glove, concierge has the items. Stay extra cautious on piers today. :raised_hands:
